verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a secret-detection CLI and GitHub Action. It has no first-party concept of user-defined automations that it could version, review, or roll back, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Its config file (gitleaks.toml) can live in a repo and be versioned with git, but that versioning comes from the host platform and the user's own setup, not from Gitleaks, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
